title: Kavya on the board examination day
body: Kavya, a Class 12 student, stayed up past midnight revising for her first board examination. In bed she kept tossing and turning, picturing herself failing and telling herself, 'I will never be good enough.' In the morning she skipped breakfast and drank three cups of strong coffee to stay alert. When the question paper was handed out, her heart was pounding, her palms were sweaty and her mind seemed to go blank. Even questions she had practised many times looked unfamiliar, and she kept thinking about what her parents and teachers would say if she did badly. In class tests, where she felt relaxed, Kavya usually scored very well.
